title: Milestone 1.5: the rest of machine, settings and DOS audio
summary: The start-up check screen before play, the HUD's toast line and level-name banner, and a first listen to DOS audio on real hardware.

title: Milestone 2: the content pipeline
summary: fizz-bake and the first Level Studio script baked into a Fizz Asset Pack (`.FAP`).

title: Milestone 3: scene intent and the camera
summary: fizz-engine, the scene contract and a camera with Fizz 1's pixel-locking, on Web and DOS.

title: Milestone 3.5: mechanics roster
summary: Wall-kick first, because the lighthouse level is vertical, then ladders, vines, mantle, lifts, switches and the enemy AI set. A placeholder with no start date.

title: Milestone 4: audio
summary: Fizz 1's other sound effects with the full caption table, stereo-authored effects, and the IMF lab's songs in place of the placeholder level music.

summary: Cycle and size budgets against a 486DX model, gated in CI.

title: Milestone 6: shell
summary: Title, pause, options, four save slots, result cards and the opening cinematic. A placeholder with no start date.
